title: East Nashville Rooftop Escape | Views | Walkable
description:
Experience the creative heart of Music City from our huge rooftop. Located in Nashville’s most vibrant neighborhood, our modern three-story home combines East Side soul with rare luxury amenities; including a private elevator serving every floor.

The space
⬥ Massive Rooftop Deck for sunset toasts and group hangs with neighborhood views.
⬥ Private Elevator to move luggage and groceries between all floors.
⬥ Two quiet bedrooms featuring Queen beds with luxury linens and plush mattresses.
⬥ Social Ground Floor: An open-concept living area with a Smart TV and a Queen sofa bed for extra guests.
⬥ Fully equipped kitchen with new appliances and a dedicated coffee bar station.
⬥ On-site parking provided (best for compact cars) plus additional guest parking.
⬥ Secure, smart-lock entry with a unique code for your stay.

THE LAYOUT:
⬥ Level 1 & 2: Quiet, private bedrooms designed for deep sleep and relaxation.
⬥ Level 3: The social heart of the home, featuring the kitchen, dining, and main living area.
⬥ The Top: Huge rooftop entertainment deck.

Guest access
The entire space is yours. Please make yourself at home. We utilize a digital lock with your own unique code that is emailed to you two days before check-in.

Other things to note
PLEASE NOTE:
⬥ We use green & organic cleaning supplies
⬥ There is additional first-come first-serve parking in front of the building.
